description: Source code for EffectsFactoryState, including effect lookup, UUID conversion, and effect descriptor dumping functions.

methods.name: findEffect
methods.description: Searches for an effect by UUID or type within the library list, returning the library and effect descriptor if found.

methods.name: stringToUuid
methods.description: Converts a UUID string to an effect_uuid_t structure.

methods.name: uuidToString
methods.description: Converts an effect_uuid_t structure to its string representation.

methods.name: dumpEffectDescriptor
methods.description: Outputs a formatted string describing an effect descriptor, including UUID, name, and flags.
